evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from 28766 to 15 ppm, and it has stayed at 4-7 ppm since then
Temperature followed the ramp setpoint closely, overshot by about 10 °C at the start of growth, and has settled to 752 °C against a 750 °C setpoint
Heater power fell from about 81% while ramping to 38-41% while holding temperature, which is consistent with the controller just maintaining 750 °C
Ar flow is steady at about 100 sccm and pressure at about 3.0 Torr

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet. The next few growth readings should also confirm the temperature settles fully at the setpoint, since no normal-run reference values were given for comparison.
